sentences.en: A. Of all mankind's manifold creations, language must take pride of place.
sentences.zh: A. 在人类所有的创造物中,语言必须占据首要地位。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Other inventions - the wheel, agriculture, sliced bread - may have transformed our material existence, but the advent of language is what made us human.
sentences.zh: 其他发明——轮子、农业、切片面包——可能改变了我们的物质存在,但语言的出现才使我们成为人类。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Compared to language, all other inventions pale in significance, since everything we have ever achieved depends on language and originates from it.
sentences.zh: 与语言相比,所有其他的发明都显得苍白无力,因为我们所取得的一切成就都依赖于语言并源于语言。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Without language, we could never have embarked on our ascent to unparalleled power over all other animals, and even over nature itself.
sentences.zh: 如果没有语言,我们永远不可能获得超越所有其他动物,甚至超越自然本身的无与伦比的力量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B. But language is foremost not just because it came first.
sentences.zh: B. 但语言之所以重要,不仅仅是因为它是第一位的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In its own right it is a tool of extraordinary sophistication, yet based on an idea of ingenious simplicity: 'this marvellous invention of composing out of twenty-five or thirty sounds that infinite variety of expressions which, whilst having in themselves no likeness to what is in our mind, allow us to disclose to others its whole secret, and to make known to those who cannot penetrate it all that we imagine, and all the various stirrings of our soul.
sentences.zh: 就其本身而言,它是一种极其复杂的工具,但却基于一种巧妙简单的想法：“这个奇妙的发明,用二十五种或三十种声音组成了无数种表达方式,虽然它们本身与我们头脑中的东西并不相似,但它允许我们向他人透露它的全部秘密,并让那些无法洞察它的人知道我们所想象的一切,以及我们灵魂的所有各种激动。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This was how, in 1660, the renowned French grammarians of the Port-Royal abbey near Versailles distilled the essence of language, and no one since has celebrated more eloquently the magnitude of its achievement.
sentences.zh: 1660 年,凡尔赛宫附近皇家港口修道院的著名法国语法学家就是这样提炼出语言本质的,此后无人更雄辩地庆祝其成就的巨大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Even so, there is just one flaw in all these hymns of praise, for the homage to language's unique accomplishment conceals a simple yet critical incongruity.
sentences.zh: 即便如此,所有这些赞美诗都只有一个缺陷,因为对语言独特成就的致敬掩盖了一种简单但关键的不协调。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Language is mankind's greatest invention - except, of course, that it was never invented.
sentences.zh: 语言是人类最伟大的发明——当然,除了它从未被发明过。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This apparent paradox is at the core of our fascination with language, and it holds many of its secrets.
sentences.zh: 这种明显的悖论是我们对语言着迷的核心,它蕴藏着许多秘密。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C. Language often seems so skillfully drafted that one can hardly imagine it as anything other than the perfected handiwork of a master craftsman.
sentences.zh: C. 语言常常看起来是如此巧妙地起草,以至于人们很难想象它不是一位大师级工匠的完美手工作品。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: How else could this instrument make so much out of barely three dozen measly morsels of sound?
sentences.zh: 要不然这个乐器怎么能从区区三打的声音中发出如此多的声音呢？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In themselves, these configurations of mouth – p, f, b, v, t, d, k, g, s, h, a, e and so on - amount to nothing more than a few haphazard spits and splutters, random noises with no meaning, no ability to express, no power to explain.
sentences.zh: 就其本身而言,这些嘴型——p、f、b、v、t、d、k、g、s、h、a、e等等——只不过是一些随意的吐口水和杂音,毫无意义、没有表达能力、没有解释能力的随机噪音。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But run them through the cogs and wheels of the language machine, let it arrange them in some very special orders, and there is nothing that these meaningless streams of air cannot do: from sighing the interminable boredom of existence to unravelling the fundamental order of the universe.
sentences.zh: 但是让它们穿过语言机器的齿轮和轮子,让它以一些非常特殊的顺序排列它们,这些无意义的气流无所不能：从叹息存在的无休无止的无聊到解开宇宙的基本秩序。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D. The most extraordinary thing about language, however, is that one doesn't have to be a genius to set its wheels in motion.
sentences.zh: D. 然而,关于语言的最非凡的事情是,一个人不必是天才才能启动它的轮子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The language machine allows just about everybody - from pre-modern foragers in the subtropical savannah, to post-modern philosophers in the suburban sprawl - to tie these meaningless sounds together into an infinite variety of subtle senses, and all apparently without the slightest exertion.
sentences.zh: 语言机器几乎允许每个人——从亚热带大草原上的前现代采集者,到郊区蔓延的后现代哲学家——将这些无意义的声音联系在一起,形成无限多种微妙的感觉,而这一切显然不需要丝毫的努力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Yet it is precisely this deceptive ease which makes language a victim of its own success, since in everyday life its triumphs are usually taken for granted.
sentences.zh: 然而,正是这种具有欺骗性的轻松使语言成为其自身成功的受害者,因为在日常生活中,语言的胜利通常被认为是理所当然的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The wheels of language run so smoothly that one rarely bothers to stop and think about all the resourcefulness and expertise that must have gone into making it tick.
sentences.zh: 语言的车轮运转得如此顺利,以至于人们很少停下来思考让它运转所需的所有足智多谋和专业知识。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Language conceals art.
sentences.zh: 语言掩盖了艺术。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: E. Often, it is only the estrangement of foreign tongues, with their many exotic and outlandish features, that brings home the wonder of language's design.
sentences.zh: E. 通常,只有外语的疏远及其许多异国情调和古怪的特征,才能让人们认识到语言设计的奇妙。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One of the showiest stunts that some languages can pull off is an ability to build up words of breath-breaking length, and thus express in one word what English takes a whole sentence to say.
sentences.zh: 某些语言最引人注目的特技之一是能够构建令人惊叹的长度单词,从而用一个单词表达英语需要整个句子才能表达的内容。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The Turkish word şehirliliştiremediklerimizdensiniz, to take one example, means nothing less than 'you are one of those whom we can't turn into a town-dweller?
sentences.zh: 举个例子,土耳其语单词 şehirliliştiremediklerimizdensiniz 的意思无非是“你是那些我们无法变成城镇居民的人之一？”

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: (In case you were wondering, this monstrosity really is one word, not merely many different words squashed together - most of its components cannot even stand up on their own.)
sentences.zh: （如果你想知道的话,这个怪物实际上是一个词,而不仅仅是许多不同的词挤在一起 - 它的大部分组成部分甚至无法独立站立。）

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F. And if that sounds like some one-off freak, then consider Sumerian, the language spoken on the banks of the Euphrates some 5,000 years ago by the people who invented writing and thus enabled the documentation of history.
sentences.zh: F. 如果这听起来像是一次性的怪胎,那么请考虑一下苏美尔语,这是一种大约 5,000 年前在幼发拉底河沿岸由发明文字并由此实现历史记录的人们所使用的语言。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: A Sumerian word like munintumaa ('when he had made it suitable for her') might seem rather trim compared to the Turkish colossus above.
sentences.zh: 与上面的土耳其巨像相比,像 munintumaa（“当他使它适合她时”）这样的苏美尔词可能显得相当简洁。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: What is so impressive about it, however, is not its lengthiness but rather the reverse - the thrifty compactness of its construction.
sentences.zh: 然而,它令人印象深刻的不是它的冗长,而是相反——它的结构节俭紧凑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The word is made up of different slots, each corresponding to a particular portion of meaning.
sentences.zh: 该单词由不同的槽组成,每个槽对应于含义的特定部分。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This sleek design allows single sounds to convey useful information, and in fact even the absence of a sound has been enlisted to express something specific.
sentences.zh: 这种时尚的设计允许单个声音传达有用的信息,事实上,即使没有声音也可以表达特定的东西。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: If you were to ask which bit in the Sumerian word corresponds to the pronoun 'it' in the English translation 'when he had made it suitable for her, then the answer would have to be nothing.
sentences.zh: 如果你问苏美尔语单词中的哪一位对应于英语翻译中的代词“it”“when he had made it beautiful for she”,那么答案一定是“什么都没有”。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Mind you, a very particular kind of nothing: the nothing that stands in the empty slot in the middle.
sentences.zh: 请注意,这是一种非常特殊的“无”：位于中间空槽中的“无”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The technology is so fine-tuned then that even a non-sound, when carefully placed in a particular position, has been invested with a specific function.
sentences.zh: 当时的技术是如此精细,即使是非声音,当小心地放置在特定位置时,也被赋予了特定的功能。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Who could possibly have come up with such a nifty contraption?
sentences.zh: 谁能想出这么漂亮的装置？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。
